name: 108WP Content Protector Lite
author: 108WP

sections.description:
108WP Content Protector Lite provides essential protection for your WordPress content. Perfect for protecting your blog posts, articles, and pages from casual content theft and scraping.

Free Features

  • ✅ Disable Right-Click – Prevents context menu access
  • ✅ Disable Left-Click – Prevents text selection via mouse
  • ✅ Disable Print – Blocks Ctrl+P and print dialog
  • ✅ Disable Save – Prevents Ctrl+S save dialog
  • ✅ Disable Developer Tools – Blocks F12, Ctrl+Shift+I, etc.
  • ✅ … and 13 more human protection features (18 total included free)!

Pro Features (Upgrade Required)

  • 🔒 AI Bot Blocking (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, +13 more)
  • 🔒 Invisible Watermarking
  • 🔒 Robots.txt Editor
  • 🔒 Activity Logging
  • 🔒 Custom Messages
  • 🔒 Page-Level Protection
  • 🔒 Multi-Language Support

Upgrade to Pro →

Why Content Protection?

Protect your intellectual property from:
* Content scrapers and copycats
* Unauthorized republishing
* Image theft
* Text copying

Easy to Use

  1. Install and activate the plugin
  2. Go to 108WP Protector in WordPress admin
  3. Enable desired protections
  4. Save and test on your site

SEO Safe

All protections are SEO-friendly and won’t affect:
* Search engine indexing
* Google rankings
* Page speed
* User experience (for legitimate visitors)

Support & Documentation

  • Documentation
  • Support Forum
  • Pro Version

Privacy Policy

108WP Content Protector Lite does not collect, store, or transmit any personal data. All protections are applied locally on your WordPress site.
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation

  1. Go to Plugins > Add New in WordPress admin
  2. Search for “108WP Content Protector Lite”
  3. Click Install Now
  4. Activate the plugin

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin ZIP file
  2. Go to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin
  3. Choose the ZIP file and click Install Now
  4. Activate the plugin
sections.faq:
Is this plugin free?

Yes! The Lite version includes 18 human protection features completely free. For advanced features like AI bot blocking, watermarking, and activity logging, upgrade to Pro.

Will this affect SEO?

No. The human protections are applied via JavaScript and don’t affect search engine crawlers or your SEO rankings.

Does it work on mobile?

Yes! All protections work on both desktop and mobile devices.

Can I exclude administrators?

This feature is available in the Pro version only.

What’s the difference between Lite and Pro?

Lite: Includes all 18 human content protections (disable right click, printing, dev tools, etc).
Pro: Adds AI bot blocking, invisible watermarking, robots.txt editor, activity logging, custom messages, and page-level controls.

How do I upgrade to Pro?

Visit 108wp.com to purchase the Pro version.
